what: The dialog grows out from the position, size and corners of the pressed spot (button·card). The panel’s top·right·width·height·border-radius expand over 460ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) to the target place (440 wide·screen height −100px at 50px from the top right, or screen center·16:9 video window), and the backdrop spreads over the same length while blurring 3px. The text inside rises .26s after half of that length. On close, the button’s current position is measured again and the dialog shrinks back into it

options.place: corner (default — 50px from the top, the right side keeps the button’s right margin as is) · center (screen center) · video (centered 16:9, width capped at 1120)
options.w: Panel width in px, default 440 (never exceeds screen width −40)
options.h: Panel height in px, default screen height −100
options.radius: Open panel corner radius in px, default 16 (12 for video)
options.dur: Growth duration in ms, default 460 — 0 means instant
options.from: Outer element css to grow (default pressed button) — so it grows across the whole card even when the button inside the card is pressed
options.[data-fx-part=open·layer·scrim·panel·con: Open button (multiple allowed) · cover · curtain · panel · panel text · close
options.fx:open·fx:close: Send to the element to open and close it

use: …

from.where: index.html waitlist in the video card (from the whole card to the top right, place: corner) · video in the still frame (place: video) · feature list in the feature card chip (place: center) — original useMorphPanel MORPH_MS 460

note: The cover is position: fixed, so if it is placed inside an ancestor with transform or filter it grows relative to that ancestor — in that case put the part element directly under body. While open it locks document scroll (if using Lenis, stop · start when window.lenis exists)
